method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks sink as chip rout deepens, oil set for weekly gain
Equities.reason: Global equity risk tone driven lower by a broadening chip selloff; chip weakness is the dominant market narrative and is weighing on indices beyond tech, making this a meaningful negative for equities.

Equities.title: Market Is So Risk-On That Path Higher Looks Tough
Equities.reason: Macro commentary that markets are stretched/overbought — implies elevated vulnerability to pullbacks and a tougher near-term path higher for broad equities (negative risk sentiment).

Equities.title: Chip Stocks Extend Rout as TSMC Results Fall Short of High Bar
Equities.reason: TSMC/semiconductor earnings and outlook disappointment is cascading through chip suppliers and AI supply chain — a high-relevance, market-wide negative for tech and indices.

Equities.title: Among AI crowd, some investors position for slower hyperscaler spending growth
Equities.reason: Shifts in investor expectations for hyperscaler/AI capex directly feed the AI leadership narrative; downgrades to expected spending growth are a negative for AI-exposed tech equities.

Equities.title: Global stocks fall as AI trade goes into reverse
Equities.summary: Investors pull back from high-flying technology shares
Equities.reason: Concise statement of the dominant market regime shift — a reversal of the AI-led rally — making this a clear, high-relevance negative for global equities.

Equities.title: China Chip Stock Pullback Drives Investor Fear to Four-Year High
Equities.reason: Rising investor fear in China tech/chips underscores contagion risk from US/Asia semiconductor weakness into regional equity markets — material negative for risk assets.

Equities.title: Hong Kong Stocks’ Discount to China Widens on Liquidity Pressure
Equities.reason: Liquidity-driven widening of Hong Kong discounts signals regional equity market stress and capital-flow strain — a noteworthy negative for China/HK equities and EM sentiment.

Equities.title: Netflix shares slide on disappointing growth forecasts
Equities.summary: Streaming giant projects weakest revenue increase in three years
Equities.reason: Large-cap tech earnings miss and slower growth outlook hit a market leader — an idiosyncratic but still meaningful negative signal for sentiment toward growth/media names.

Equities.title: Wall Street ends lower as chip weakness offsets solid earnings, economic data
Equities.reason: Market-close summary showing chip-led losses outweighing positives — confirms the chips/tech-led deterioration is the dominant near-term driver for US equities.

Equities.title: SoftBank sinks over 9% as Asia chip stocks track Wall Street AI sell-off
Equities.summary: Japanese AI-linked stocks tumbled as a fresh rout in U.S. semiconductor shares spread across Asia after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing's outlook failed to reassure investors.
Equities.reason: Regional contagion example: a major Asian conglomerate tied to AI investments falling sharply underscores spillover from US chip/AI disappointment to Asian equities.

Equities.title: Xi pitches China as AI partner to developing world, warns against risks and security overreach
Equities.summary: China will provide developing countries with 5,000 opportunities in AI training and seminar programs, as well as develop AI cooperation with various blocs.
Equities.reason: Policy push by Beijing to lead AI internationally is a supportive, idiosyncratic positive for China/AI-related equities over the medium term, but lower relevance versus the global selloff narrative.

Equities.title: Foreign investors sweeten on Indian government bonds as equities see a sell-off
Equities.summary: The Indian government bond market is drawing interest from foreign investors as it readies for a likely inclusion in Bloomberg index.
Equities.reason: Flow shift into Indian bonds while equities are sold off signals risk-off repositioning and potential downward pressure on local equities; relevant regional equity implication.

Rates.title: Dallas Fed President Logan calls for 'modestly' higher interest rates
Rates.summary: The policymaker said this week's good inflation news wasn't good enough.
Rates.reason: Hawkish Fed official signalling support for higher rates reinforces a 'higher-for-longer' yields narrative. Material for rates markets but not an extraordinary shock on its own.

Rates.title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh faces an inflation credibility test after Congress hearings
Rates.summary: The new Fed chairman avoided major stumbles in two days of testimony before the House and Senate, but faces a rapid test of his commitment to price stability.
Rates.reason: Focus on Fed chair's inflation credibility increases likelihood of policy tightening or persistence, supporting higher yields; important context for rate expectations.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are high-impact for rates. Given the prevailing market narrative of sticky inflation and hawkish Fed commentary, the minutes likely reinforce upside pressure on yields and rate-hike vigilance.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.reason: Discount rate meeting minutes provide additional signals on central bank operational stance; likely supportive of modestly higher rates narrative but lower market impact than FOMC minutes.

Rates.title: Dollar Falls with Bond Yields on Favorable US Producer Prices
Rates.reason: Headline reports show bond yields falling alongside the dollar after favourable PPI—indicates a bond rally/cooling near-term inflation signal, which is positive for bond prices (yields down).

Rates.title: Mortgage rates jump to highest level in almost a year
Rates.reason: Rising mortgage rates reflect upward pressure on long-end yields and tighter financial conditions; relevant to broader rates market and credit-sensitive segments.

Rates.title: Sharp Drop in Diesel Supplies Threatens to Rev Up Inflation Again
Rates.reason: Commodity-driven upside inflation risk (diesel supply drop) increases the chance of renewed inflationary pressure, which would be negative for bond prices (yields higher).

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar rebounds as US-Iran tensions flare up
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Friday, July 17:
FX.reason: Headline market summary: escalating US–Iran tensions are driving safe‑haven flows into the USD and reviving Fed hike bets — broad USD strength that pressures major USD‑pairs and sets the dominant FX regime today.

FX.title: Japanese Yen softens on renewed US-Iran tensions, Japan flags intervention risk
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair posts modest gains near 162.40 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) as the United States (US) launches a new wave of strikes against Iran for a sixth night in a row.
FX.reason: USD safe‑haven flows are weakening the JPY (USD/JPY higher), a major FX move; mention of intervention risk is important but the immediate effect is JPY weakness amid geopolitical demand for USD.

FX.title: Japan’s Katayama says ready to act on currency moves whenever necessary
FX.summary: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the authorities are ready to act on currency moves whenever necessary.
FX.reason: Explicit official readiness to intervene is a high‑impact FX policy signal that can cap JPY weakness and support the yen — a positive (non‑USD) FX shock even as USD safe‑haven flows persist.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan loses as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CNH gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 6.7760 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from escalating developments surrounding conflicts in the Middle East.
FX.reason: Safe‑haven USD demand is pushing USD/CNH higher — direct FX transmission of geopolitical risk into EM FX, reinforcing the broader USD‑bid narrative.

FX.title: Indian Rupee ticks up on RBI’s intervention, downside remains favored
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) while entering the weekend. The USD/INR pair ticks down to near 96.30 as the Indian currency rises, following Reserve Bank of India’s intervention.
FX.reason: Active RBI intervention supporting the INR is a direct central‑bank FX action that temporarily offsets broader USD strength — positive for that local currency versus USD.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar holds near one-month top as bullish oil offsets Fed hike bets and firm USD
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on the overnight bounce from the vicinity of the 1.4000 psychological mark, or a one-month low, and attracts some sellers during the Asian session on Friday.
FX.reason: Oil‑driven CAD strength is offsetting some USD pressure — commodity/currency channel (CAD) provides a local counter‑flow to the USD safe‑haven impulse, but scope is limited.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Stays pressured below mid-1.1400s after failing near 200-SMA on H4
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair ticks lower for the second straight day on Friday as energy-driven inflation fears revive US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike bets and support the US Dollar (USD) amid escalating US-Iran tensions.
FX.reason: EURUSD pressured by a stronger USD on Fed‑rate/higher energy inflation and geopolitical risk — a direct reflection of the dominant USD‑bid across major crosses.

FX.title: British Pound weakens below 1.3500 as US launches new wave of strikes against Iran
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades on a softer note around 1.3470 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East trigger risk-off market sentiment and weigh on the Cable. The preliminary reading of the Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index
FX.reason: GBP weakening reflects broad risk‑off and USD safe‑haven flows tied to the Middle East escalation — another major‑pair example of the dominant USD strength.

FX.title: Australian Dollar moves away from three-week top as geopolitics and Fed hike bets lift USD
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair remains on the back foot for the second straight day and slides to the 0.7980 region during the Asian session on Friday.
FX.reason: AUD is retreating as USD strength (geopolitics + Fed‑bets) drags on risk‑sensitive currencies — reinforces the cross‑market USD‑bid narrative affecting risk FX.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: EIA confirms persistent Strait of Hormuz disruptions as a primary driver of higher and more volatile crude prices in 2Q26 — a broad, market-moving supply-risk narrative that is strongly bullish for oil.

Commodities.title: U.S. exports of crude oil and petroleum products reached record in April
Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: Record US exports reflect redirected flows and stronger global demand amid Middle East disruptions — supportive for global oil prices, though partly supply-side in nature (US-driven).

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: Sharp drawdowns at Cushing lower available WTI storage and tighten near-term physical balances — a bullish technical/fundamental signal for WTI prices.

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise as U.S.-Iran hostilities threaten supply through Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: Oil prices rose Friday as investors weighed escalating threats between the U.S. and Iran.
Commodities.reason: Market reaction to escalating U.S.-Iran hostilities is lifting the oil risk premium and prompting near-term price upside — directly market-moving for crude benchmarks.

Commodities.title: Oil pipelines around the Strait of Hormuz won't end the threat Iran poses to Middle East crude exports
Commodities.summary: Oil producers are building or contemplating new pipeline projects to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, but this infrastructure is still vulnerable, analysts said.
Commodities.reason: Analysis that pipeline alternatives do not remove Strait-of-Hormuz risk supports a sustained oil risk premium — a constructive backdrop for prices, though more structural/medium-term in tone.

Commodities.title: Iran’s IRGC says no oil or gas will be exported through Hormuz as long as US attacks continue
Commodities.summary: The Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) said that no oil or gas will be exported through the Strait of Hormuz as long as US attacks continue, Tasnim news agency reported on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Explicit threat to shut exports through Hormuz is a direct supply-shock risk for oil/gas flows — highly market-relevant and strongly bullish for crude and regional energy markets.

Commodities.title: WTI extends range play around $79.00; bullish potential intact amid Mideast tensions
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US crude oil price – edges higher during the Asian session on Friday, though it remains confined within a multi-day-old range.
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical note showing modest upside within a range; limited relevance per framework (price/technical focus capped).

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade and expanding US export capacity point to stronger global gas demand and tighter balances — constructive for natural gas/LNG prices.

Commodities.title: The United States produced more crude oil than any other country in 2025
Commodities.summary: The United States remained the world's largest crude oil producer in 2025, according to our International Energy Statistics database, extending a streak that began in 2018 when the United States overtook Russia to become the world's leading producer.
Commodities.reason: High US production is a structural supply factor that can cap upside for oil — a meaningful counter-signal to Middle East disruption-driven tightness, but lower relevance vs. acute supply-risk headlines.

Commodities.title: Gold on track for biggest weekly loss in six as Iran war fans inflation worries
Commodities.reason: Headline indicates gold selling amid rising Fed-hike bets and higher real yields despite geopolitical inflationary risk — net negative for bullion in the current market narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to modest recovery gains near $4,000; not out of the woods amid Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its modest recovery gains around the $4,000 psychological mark heading into the European session on Friday, though any meaningful appreciation seems elusive.
Commodities.reason: Price/technical note pointing to limited upside as hawkish Fed outlook and firm USD constrain gold; relevance capped due to technical focus.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $55.50 amid interest rate concerns
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around $55.50 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Thursday. Silver is on track to drop over 7% this week as escalating Middle East tensions drive oil prices up.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-focused piece linking weak silver to rising rates and spillover from energy-led dynamics; relevance limited by forecast/technical nature.

Commodities.title: Rio Tinto cuts copper unit costs nearly in half for 2026
Commodities.reason: Company-level cost reductions at a major miner may ease copper supply-side pressure and be modestly price-negative, but the signal is idiosyncratic and lower relevance for the global copper market.

Crypto.title: U.S. adds four Iran central bank crypto wallets to sanctions, Tether freezes $131 million of contents
Crypto.reason: Major sanctions action plus a large stablecoin freeze are clear regulatory/enforcement signals that raise compliance risk and counterparty/custody concerns for the crypto market; material negative for risk appetite and decentralization narrative.

Crypto.title: $1.9 trillion asset manager T. Rowe Price bets on active management with first multi-token crypto ETF
Crypto.reason: Large, traditional asset manager launching a multi-token ETF is a strong institutional-adoption signal that materially supports crypto market legitimacy and inflows; significant positive for market structure and demand.

Crypto.title: Citadel Securities invests $400 million in Crypto.com, valuing exchange at $20 billion
Crypto.reason: Large strategic investment from a major market maker into a crypto exchange bolsters institutional infrastructure, liquidity and perceived legitimacy — constructive for market confidence and exchange ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Ether outruns bitcoin as ETF money returns, almost all of from BlackRock's fund
Crypto.reason: ETF flow concentration into ETH (esp. from a large provider) is a clear demand driver that shifts market leadership and raises odds of continued inflows — positive for ETH and broader institutional adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: DTCC moves tokenized securities into live trading, marking a milestone for Wall Street's blockchain push
Crypto.reason: DTCC deploying live tokenized securities is a meaningful institutional infrastructure milestone that supports long-term crypto market integration and use-cases beyond speculation.

Crypto.title: Visa backs Open USD with new stablecoin platform as Circle faces fresh competition
Crypto.reason: Visa entering stablecoin rails with Open USD is a material market-structure development that increases mainstream payments adoption and competition in the stablecoin space — net positive for crypto rails and on-chain activity.

Crypto.title: Galaxy targets institutional stablecoin yield with new DeFi vaults
Crypto.reason: Product launches aimed at institutional stablecoin yield point to growing institutional engagement with DeFi strategies and more on-chain demand for stablecoins — constructive but more tactical than system-changing.

Crypto.title: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets to expand institutional crypto business
Crypto.reason: Acquisition to expand institutional trading capabilities supports liquidity and market-making depth — positive for trading infrastructure and institutional participation.

Crypto.title: Crypto brokerage firm Alpaca raises $135 million for tokenized stock infrastructure
Crypto.reason: Fundraising for tokenized stock infrastructure indicates continued investment in tokenized assets and cross-market product expansion — constructive for long-term ecosystem growth.

Crypto.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
Crypto.reason: Collaboration on blockchain IPO infrastructure is a positive signal for institutional issuance on-chain, though it's an incremental infrastructure story with limited immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: The Clarity Act is the most important consumer protection effort in years
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity/consumer-protection frameworks reduce legal uncertainty and can broaden adoption; viewed as net constructive for institutional and retail confidence in crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin under $63,000 after new U.S. strike on Iran. Trump's China comment adds to uncertainty
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical shock (military strike) triggering crypto downside demonstrates crypto's sensitivity to risk aversion and safe-haven flows; negative for near-term risk appetite and price action.

Crypto.title: Two groups of crypto investors are selling bitcoin to cap its latest price recovery
Crypto.reason: On-chain/flow evidence of selling by key investor cohorts is a clear near-term supply pressure signal that can cap rallies and increase volatility — negative for short-term price momentum.

Crypto.title: A bitcoin wallet dormant since the 2017 peak just moved $383 million
Crypto.reason: Large movement from a long-dormant wallet can presage selling or redistribution of supply, adding to short-term downside risk and market uncertainty.
